summary_zh: 1839 年达盖尔摄影法在巴黎公开；1888 年柯达推出卷片相机，1900 年低价 Brownie 进一步降低使用门槛，让日常摄影走向大众。
summary_en: The daguerreotype was announced in Paris in 1839. Kodak’s 1888 roll-film camera and the affordable Brownie of 1900 brought everyday photography to a wider public.
